1.text: Tha Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave 2 him, 2 show 2 his servants things which must shortly come 2 pass; N he sent N signified it by his angel 2 his servant John:
Who bare record of tha word of God, N of tha testimony of Jesus Christ, N of all things dat he saw.
Blessed is he dat readeth, N dey dat hear tha words of dis prophecy, N keep dose things which r written in it: 4 tha time is at hand.
John 2 tha seven churches which r in Asia: Grace be 2 u, N peace, from him which is, N which was, N which is 2 come; N from tha seven Spirits which r before his throne;
N from Jesus Christ, who is tha faithful witness, N tha first begotten of tha dead, N tha prince of tha kings of tha earth. 2 him dat loved us, N washed us from our sins in his own blood,
N has made us kings N priests 2 God N his Father; 2 him be glory N dominion 4 ever N ever. Amen.
Look, he comes wit clouds; N every eye shall see him, N dey also which pierced him: N all kindreds of tha earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.
I am Alpha N Omega, tha beginning N tha ending, says tha Lord, which is, N which was, N which is 2 come, tha Almighty.
I John, who also am ur brother, N companion in tribulation, N in tha kingdom N patience of Jesus Christ, was in tha isle dat is called Patmos, 4 tha word of God, N 4 tha testimony of Jesus Christ.
I was in tha Spirit on tha Lord’s day, N heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,

Sayin, I am Alpha N Omega, tha first N tha last: N, What u see, write in a book, N send it 2 tha seven churches which r in Asia; 2 Ephesus, N 2 Smyrna, N 2 Pergamos, N 2 Thyatira, N 2 Sardis, N 2 Philadelphia, N 2 Laodicea.
N I turned 2 see tha voice dat spoke wit me. N bein turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks;
N in tha midst of tha seven candlesticks one like 2 tha Son of man, clothed wit a garment down 2 tha foot, N girt about tha paps wit a golden girdle.
His head N his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; N his eyes were as a flame of fire;
N his feet like 2 fine brass, as if dey burned in a furnace; N his voice as tha sound of many waterz.
N he had in his right hand seven stars: N out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: N his countenance was as tha sun shines in his strength.
N when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. N he laid his right hand upon me, sayin 2 me, don’t fear; I am tha first N tha last:
I am he dat lives, N was dead; N, look, I am alive 4 evermore, Amen; N have tha keys of hell N of death.
Write tha things which u have seen, N tha things which r, N tha things which shall be hereafter;

Tha mystery of tha seven stars which u saw in my right hand, N tha seven golden candlesticks. tha seven stars r tha angels of tha seven churches: N tha seven candlesticks which u saw r tha seven churches.

2.text: 2 tha angel of tha church of Ephesus write; dese things says he dat holds tha seven stars in his right hand, who walks in tha midst of tha seven golden candlesticks;
I know ur works, N ur labour, N ur patience, N how u can not bear ’em which r evil: N u have tried ’em which say dey r apostles, N r not, N have found ’em liars:
N have borne, N have patience, N 4 my name’s sake have laboured, N have not fainted.
Nevertheless I have somewhat against u, because u have left ur first love.
Remember therefore from from where u r fallen, N repent, N do tha first works; or else I will come 2 u quickly, N will remove ur candlestick out of his place, except u repent.
But dis u have, dat u hate tha deeds of tha Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
He dat has an ear, let him hear what tha Spirit says 2 tha churches; 2 him dat overcomes will I give 2 eat of tha tree of life, which is in tha midst of tha paradise of God.
N 2 tha angel of tha church in Smyrna write; dese things says tha first N tha last, which was dead, N is alive;
I know ur works, N tribulation, N poverty, (but u r rich) N I know tha blasphemy of ’em which say dey r Jews, N r not, but r tha synagogue of Satan.

Fear none of dose things which u will suffer: look, tha devil shall cast some of u in2 prison, dat y’all may be tried; N y’all shall have tribulation ten days: be u faithful 2 death, N I will give u a crown of life.
He dat has an ear, let him hear what tha Spirit says 2 tha churches; He dat overcomes shall not be hurt of tha second death.
N 2 tha angel of tha church in Pergamos write; dese things says he which has tha sharp sword wit two edges;

I know ur works, N where u dwell, even where Satan’s seat is: N u hold fast my name, N have not denied my faith, even in dose days in which Antipas was my faithful martyr, who was killed among u, where Satan lives.

But I have a few things against u, because u have there ’em dat hold tha doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balac 2 cast a stumblingblock before tha children of Israel, 2 eat things sacrificed 2 idols, N 2 commit fornication.
So have u also ’em dat hold tha doctrine of tha Nicolaitans, which thing I hate.
Repent; or else I will come 2 u quickly, N will fight against ’em wit tha sword of my mouth.

He dat has an ear, let him hear what tha Spirit says 2 tha churches; 2 him dat overcomes will I give 2 eat of tha hidden manna, N will give him a white stone, N in tha stone a new name written, which no man knows saving he dat receives it.
N 2 tha angel of tha church in Thyatira write; dese things says tha Son of God, who has his eyes like 2 a flame of fire, N his feet r like fine brass;
I know ur works, N charity, N service, N faith, N ur patience, N ur works; N tha last 2 be more than tha first.
Even so I have a few things against u, because u sufferest dat woman Jezebel, which calls herself a prophetess, 2 teach N 2 seduce my servants 2 commit fornication, N 2 eat things sacrificed 2 idols.
N I gave her space 2 repent of her fornication; N she repented not.
Look, I will cast her in2 a bed, N ’em dat commit adultery wit her in2 great tribulation, except dey repent of their deeds.
N I will kill her children wit death; N all tha churches shall know dat I am he which searches tha reins N hearts: N I will give 2 every one of u according 2 ur works.
But 2 u I say, N 2 tha rest in Thyatira, as many as have not dis doctrine, N which have not known tha depths of Satan, as dey speak; I will put upon u none other burden.
But dat which y’all have already hold fast till I come.
N he dat overcomes, N keeps my works 2 tha end, 2 him will I give power over tha nations:
N he shall rule ’em wit a rod of iron; as tha vessels of a potter shall dey be broken 2 shivers: even as I received of my Father.
N I will give him tha morning star.
He dat has an ear, let him hear what tha Spirit says 2 tha churches.

3.text: N 2 tha angel of tha church in Sardis write; dese things says he dat has tha seven Spirits of God, N tha seven stars; I know ur works, dat u have a name dat u live, N art dead.
Be watchful, N strengthen tha things which remain, dat r ready 2 die: 4 I have not found ur works perfect before God.
Remember therefore how u have received N heard, N hold fast, N repent. If therefore u will not watch, I will come on u as a thief, N u will not know what hour I will come upon u.
u have a few namez even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments; N dey shall walk wit me in white: 4 dey r worthy.
He dat overcomes, tha same shall be clothed in white clothing; N I will not blot out his name out of tha book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, N before his angels.
He dat has an ear, let him hear what tha Spirit says 2 tha churches.
N 2 tha angel of tha church in Philadelphia write; dese things says he dat is holy, he dat is true, he dat has tha key of David, he dat opens, N no man shuts; N shuts, N no man opens;
I know ur works: look, I have set before u an open door, N no man can shut it: 4 u have a little strength, N have kept my word, N have not denied my name.
Look, I will make ’em of tha synagogue of Satan, which say dey r Jews, N r not, but do lie; look, I will make ’em 2 come N worship before ur feet, N 2 know dat I have loved u.
Because u have kept tha word of my patience, I also will keep u from tha hour of temptation, which shall come upon all tha world, 2 try ’em dat live upon tha earth.
Look, I come quickly: hold dat fast which u have, dat no man take ur crown.

Him dat overcomes will I make a pillar in tha temple of my God, N he shall go no more out: N I will write upon him tha name of my God, N tha name of tha city of my God, which is new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God: N I will write upon him my new name.
He dat has an ear, let him hear what tha Spirit says 2 tha churches.
N 2 tha angel of tha church of tha Laodiceans write; dese things says tha Amen, tha faithful N true witness, tha beginning of tha creation of God;
I know ur works, dat u r neither cold nor hot: I would u were cold or hot.
So then because u r lukewarm, N neither cold nor hot, I will spue u out of my mouth.
Because u sayest, I am rich, N increased wit goods, N have need of nothing; N know not dat u r wretched, N miserable, N poor, N blind, N naked:
I counsel u 2 buy of me gold tried in tha fire, dat u may be rich; N white clothing, dat u may be clothed, N dat tha shame of ur nakedness do not appear; N anoint ur eyes wit eyesalve, dat u may see.
As many as I love, I rebuke N chasten: be zealous therefore, N repent.
Look, I stand at tha door, N knock: if any man hear my voice, N open tha door, I will come in 2 him, N will sup wit him, N he wit me.
2 him dat overcomes will I grant 2 sit wit me in my throne, even as I also overcame, N am set down wit my Father in his throne.
He dat has an ear, let him hear what tha Spirit says 2 tha churches.

4.text: After dis I looked, N, look, a door was opened in heaven: N tha first voice which I heard was as it were of a trumpet talking wit me; which said, Come up here, N I will show u things which must be hereafter.
N right away I was in tha spirit: N, look, a throne was set in heaven, N one sat on tha throne.
N he dat sat was 2 look upon like a jasper N a sardine stone: N there was a rainbow round about tha throne, in sight like 2 an emerald.
N round about tha throne were four N twenty seats: N upon tha seats I saw four N twenty elders sittin, clothed in white clothing; N dey had on their heads crowns of gold.
N out of tha throne proceeded lightnings N thunderings N voices: N there were seven lamps of fire burnin before tha throne, which r tha seven Spirits of God.
N before tha throne there was a sea of glass like 2 crystal: N in tha midst of tha throne, N round about tha throne, were four beasts full of eyes before N behind.
N tha first beast was like a lion, N tha second beast like a calf, N tha third beast had a face as a man, N tha fourth beast was like a flying eagle.
N tha four beasts had each of ’em six wings about him; N dey were full of eyes within: N dey rest not day N night, sayin, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, N is, N is 2 come.
N when dose beasts give glory N honour N thanks 2 him dat sat on tha throne, who lives 4 ever N ever,
Tha four N twenty elders fall down before him dat sat on tha throne, N worship him dat lives 4 ever N ever, N cast their crowns before tha throne, sayin,
u r worthy, O Lord, 2 receive glory N honour N power: 4 u have created all things, N 4 ur pleasure dey r N were created.

5.text: N I saw in tha right hand of him dat sat on tha throne a book written within N on tha backside, sealed wit seven seals.
N I saw a strong angel proclaiming wit a loud voice, Who is worthy 2 open tha book, N 2 loose tha seals of it?
N no man in heaven, nor in earth, neither under tha earth, was able 2 open tha book, neither 2 look thereon.
N I wept much, because no man was found worthy 2 open N 2 read tha book, neither 2 look thereon.
N one of tha elders says 2 me, Weep not: look, tha Lion of tha tribe of Juda, tha Root of David, has prevailed 2 open tha book, N 2 loose tha seven seals of it.

N I beheld, N, look, in tha midst of tha throne N of tha four beasts, N in tha midst of tha elders, stood a Lamb as it had been killed, havin seven horns N seven eyes, which r tha seven Spirits of God sent forth in2 all tha earth.
N he came N took tha book out of tha right hand of him dat sat upon tha throne.
N when he had taken tha book, tha four beasts N four N twenty elders fell down before tha Lamb, havin every one of ’em harps, N golden vials full of odours, which r tha prayers of saints.
N dey sung a new song, sayin, u r worthy 2 take tha book, N 2 open tha seals of it: 4 u were killed, N have redeemed us 2 God by ur blood out of every kindred, N tongue, N people, N nation;
N have made us 2 our God kings N priests: N we shall reign on tha earth.
N I beheld, N I heard tha voice of many angels round about tha throne N tha beasts N tha elders: N tha number of ’em was ten thousand times ten thousand, N thousands of thousands;
Sayin wit a loud voice, Worthy is tha Lamb dat was killed 2 receive power, N riches, N wisdom, N strength, N honour, N glory, N blessing.

N every creature which is in heaven, N on tha earth, N under tha earth, N such as r in tha sea, N all dat r in ’em, heard I sayin, Blessing, N honour, N glory, N power, be 2 him dat sits upon tha throne, N 2 tha Lamb 4 ever N ever.
N tha four beasts said, Amen. N tha four N twenty elders fell down N worshipped him dat lives 4 ever N ever.

6.text: N I saw when tha Lamb opened one of tha seals, N I heard, as it were tha noise of thunder, one of tha four beasts sayin, Come N see.
N I saw, N look a white horse: N he dat sat on him had a bow; N a crown was given 2 him: N he went forth conquering, N 2 conquer.
N when he had opened tha second seal, I heard tha second beast say, Come N see.
N there went out another horse dat was red: N power was given 2 him dat sat thereon 2 take peace from tha earth, N dat dey should kill one another: N there was given 2 him a great sword.
N when he had opened tha third seal, I heard tha third beast say, Come N see. N I beheld, N look a black horse; N he dat sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand.
N I heard a voice in tha midst of tha four beasts say, A measure of wheat 4 a penny, N three measures of barley 4 a penny; N see u hurt not tha oil N tha wine.
N when he had opened tha fourth seal, I heard tha voice of tha fourth beast say, Come N see.

N I looked, N look a pale horse: N his name dat sat on him was Death, N Hell followed wit him. N power was given 2 ’em over tha fourth part of tha earth, 2 kill wit sword, N wit hunger, N wit death, N wit tha beasts of tha earth.
N when he had opened tha fifth seal, I saw under tha altar tha souls of ’em dat were killed 4 tha word of God, N 4 tha testimony which dey held:
N dey cried wit a loud voice, sayin, How long, O Lord, holy N true, do u not judge N avenge our blood on ’em dat live on tha earth?

N white robes were given 2 every one of ’em; N it was said 2 ’em, dat dey should rest yet 4 a little season, until their fellowservants also N their brothers, dat should be killed as dey were, should be fulfilled.
N I beheld when he had opened tha sixth seal, N, look, there was a great earthquake; N tha sun became black as sackcloth of hair, N tha moon became as blood;
N tha stars of heaven fell 2 tha earth, even as a fig tree casts her untimely figs, when she is shaken of a mighty wind.
N tha heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; N every mountain N island were moved out of their places.
N tha kings of tha earth, N tha great men, N tha rich men, N tha chief captains, N tha mighty men, N every bondman, N every free man, hid themselves in tha dens N in tha rocks of tha mountains;
N said 2 tha mountains N rocks, Fall on us, N hide us from tha face of him dat sits on tha throne, N from tha wrath of tha Lamb:
4 tha great day of his wrath is come; N who shall be able 2 stand?

7.text: N after dese things I saw four angels standin on tha four corners of tha earth, holding tha four winds of tha earth, dat tha wind should not blow on tha earth, nor on tha sea, nor on any tree.
N I saw another angel ascending from tha east, havin tha seal of tha livin God: N he cried wit a loud voice 2 tha four angels, 2 whom it was given 2 hurt tha earth N tha sea,
Sayin, Hurt not tha earth, neither tha sea, nor tha trees, till we have sealed tha servants of our God in their foreheads.
N I heard tha number of ’em which were sealed: N there were sealed an hundred N forty N four thousand of all tha tribes of tha children of Israel.
Of tha tribe of Juda were sealed twelve thousand. Of tha tribe of Reuben were sealed twelve thousand. Of tha tribe of Gad were sealed twelve thousand.
Of tha tribe of Aser were sealed twelve thousand. Of tha tribe of Nepthalim were sealed twelve thousand. Of tha tribe of Manasses were sealed twelve thousand.
Of tha tribe of Simeon were sealed twelve thousand. Of tha tribe of Levi were sealed twelve thousand. Of tha tribe of Issachar were sealed twelve thousand.
Of tha tribe of Zabulon were sealed twelve thousand. Of tha tribe of Joseph were sealed twelve thousand. Of tha tribe of Benjamin were sealed twelve thousand.

After dis I beheld, N, look, a great crowd, which no man could number, of all nations, N kindreds, N people, N tongues, stood before tha throne, N before tha Lamb, clothed wit white robes, N palms in their hands;
N cried wit a loud voice, sayin, Salvation 2 our God which sits upon tha throne, N 2 tha Lamb.
N all tha angels stood round about tha throne, N about tha elders N tha four beasts, N fell before tha throne on their faces, N worshipped God,
Sayin, Amen: Blessing, N glory, N wisdom, N thanksgiving, N honour, N power, N might, be 2 our God 4 ever N ever. Amen.
N one of tha elders answered, sayin 2 me, What r dese which r arrayed in white robes? N from where came dey?
N I said 2 him, Sir, u know. N he said 2 me, dese r dey which came out of great tribulation, N have washed their robes, N made ’em white in tha blood of tha Lamb.
Therefore r dey before tha throne of God, N serve him day N night in his temple: N he dat sits on tha throne shall live among ’em.
Dey shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall tha sun light on ’em, nor any heat.
4 tha Lamb which is in tha midst of tha throne shall feed ’em, N shall lead ’em 2 livin fountains of waterz: N God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.

8.text: N when he had opened tha seventh seal, there was silence in heaven about tha space of half an hour.
N I saw tha seven angels which stood before God; N 2 ’em were given seven trumpets.

N another angel came N stood at tha altar, havin a golden censer; N there was given 2 him much incense, dat he should offer it wit tha prayers of all saints upon tha golden altar which was before tha throne.
N tha smoke of tha incense, which came wit tha prayers of tha saints, ascended up before God out of tha angel’s hand.
N tha angel took tha censer, N filled it wit fire of tha altar, N cast it in2 tha earth: N there were voices, N thunderings, N lightnings, N an earthquake.
N tha seven angels which had tha seven trumpets prepared themselves 2 sound.
Tha first angel sounded, N there followed hail N fire mingled wit blood, N dey were cast upon tha earth: N tha third part of trees was burnt up, N all green grass was burnt up.
N tha second angel sounded, N as it were a great mountain burnin wit fire was cast in2 tha sea: N tha third part of tha sea became blood;
N tha third part of tha creatures which were in tha sea, N had life, died; N tha third part of tha ships were destroyed.
N tha third angel sounded, N there fell a great star from heaven, burnin as it were a lamp, N it fell upon tha third part of tha rivers, N upon tha fountains of waterz;
N tha name of tha star is called Wormwood: N tha third part of tha waterz became wormwood; N many men died of tha waterz, because dey were made bitter.

N tha fourth angel sounded, N tha third part of tha sun was struck, N tha third part of tha moon, N tha third part of tha stars; so as tha third part of ’em was darkened, N tha day shone not 4 a third part of it, N tha night likewise.

N I beheld, N heard an angel flying through tha midst of heaven, sayin wit a loud voice, woe, woe, woe, 2 tha inhabiters of tha earth by reason of tha other voices of tha trumpet of tha three angels, which r yet 2 sound!

9.text: N tha fifth angel sounded, N I saw a star fall from heaven 2 tha earth: N 2 him was given tha key of tha bottomless pit.
N he opened tha bottomless pit; N there arose a smoke out of tha pit, as tha smoke of a great furnace; N tha sun N tha air were darkened by reason of tha smoke of tha pit.
N there came out of tha smoke locusts upon tha earth: N 2 ’em was given power, as tha scorpions of tha earth have power.
N it was commanded ’em dat dey should not hurt tha grass of tha earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree; but only dose men which have not tha seal of God in their foreheads.
N 2 ’em it was given dat dey should not kill ’em, but dat dey should be tormented five months: N their torment was as tha torment of a scorpion, when he striketh a man.
N in dose days shall men seek death, N shall not find it; N shall desire 2 die, N death shall flee from ’em.
N tha shapes of tha locusts were like 2 horses prepared 2 battle; N on their heads were as it were crowns like gold, N their faces were as tha faces of men.
N dey had hair as tha hair of women, N their teeth were as tha teeth of lions.
N dey had breastplates, as it were breastplates of iron; N tha sound of their wings was as tha sound of chariots of many horses runnin 2 battle.
N dey had tails like 2 scorpions, N there were stings in their tails: N their power was 2 hurt men five months.
N dey had a king over ’em, which is tha angel of tha bottomless pit, whose name in tha Hebrew tongue is Abaddon, but in tha Greek tongue has his name Apollyon.
One woe is past; N, look, there come two woes more hereafter.
N tha sixth angel sounded, N I heard a voice from tha four horns of tha golden altar which is before God,
Sayin 2 tha sixth angel which had tha trumpet, Loose tha four angels which r bound in tha great river Euphrates.
N tha four angels were loosed, which were prepared 4 an hour, N a day, N a month, N a year, 4 2 kill tha third part of men.
N tha number of tha army of tha horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand: N I heard tha number of ’em.

N like dis I saw tha horses in tha vision, N ’em dat sat on ’em, havin breastplates of fire, N of jacinth, N brimstone: N tha heads of tha horses were as tha heads of lions; N out of their mouths issued fire N smoke N brimstone.
By dese three was tha third part of men killed, by tha fire, N by tha smoke, N by tha brimstone, which issued out of their mouths.
4 their power is in their mouth, N in their tails: 4 their tails were like 2 serpents, N had heads, N wit ’em dey do hurt.

N tha rest of tha men which were not killed by dese plagues yet repented not of tha works of their hands, dat dey should not worship devils, N idols of gold, N silver, N brass, N stone, N of wood: which neither can see, nor hear, nor walk:
Neither repented dey of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.

10.text: N I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed wit a cloud: N a rainbow was upon his head, N his face was as it were tha sun, N his feet as pillars of fire:
N he had in his hand a little book open: N he set his right foot upon tha sea, N his left foot on tha earth,
N cried wit a loud voice, as when a lion roareth: N when he had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices.
N when tha seven thunders had uttered their voices, I was about 2 write: N I heard a voice from heaven sayin 2 me, Seal up dose things which tha seven thunders uttered, N write ’em not.
N tha angel which I saw stand upon tha sea N upon tha earth lifted up his hand 2 heaven,
N sware by him dat lives 4 ever N ever, who created heaven, N tha things dat in it r, N tha earth, N tha things dat in it r, N tha sea, N tha things which r in it, dat there should be time no longer:
But in tha days of tha voice of tha seventh angel, when he shall begin 2 sound, tha mystery of God should be finished, as he has declared 2 his servants tha prophets.
N tha voice which I heard from heaven spoke 2 me again, N said, Go N take tha little book which is open in tha hand of tha angel which stands upon tha sea N upon tha earth.
N I went 2 tha angel, N said 2 him, Give me tha little book. N he said 2 me, Take it, N eat it up; N it shall make ur belly bitter, but it shall be in ur mouth sweet as honey.
N I took tha little book out of tha angel’s hand, N ate it up; N it was in my mouth sweet as honey: N as soon as I had eaten it, my belly was bitter.
N he said 2 me, u must prophesy again before many peoples, N nations, N tongues, N kings.

11.text: N there was given me a reed like 2 a rod: N tha angel stood, sayin, Rise, N measure tha temple of God, N tha altar, N ’em dat worship in it.
But tha court which is without tha temple leave out, N measure it not; 4 it is given 2 tha Gentiles: N tha holy city shall dey tread under foot forty N two months.
N I will give power 2 my two witnesses, N dey shall prophesy a thousand two hundred N threescore days, clothed in sackcloth.
Dese r tha two olive trees, N tha two candlesticks standin before tha God of tha earth.
N if any man will hurt ’em, fire proceeds out of their mouth, N devours their opps: N if any man will hurt ’em, he must in dis manner be killed.
Dese have power 2 shut heaven, dat it rain not in tha days of their prophecy: N have power over waterz 2 turn ’em 2 blood, N 2 strike tha earth wit all plagues, as often as dey will.
N when dey shall have finished their testimony, tha beast dat ascendeth out of tha bottomless pit shall make war against ’em, N shall overcome ’em, N kill ’em.
N their dead bodies shall lie in tha street of tha great city, which spiritually is called Sodom N Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.
N dey of tha people N kindreds N tongues N nations shall see their dead bodies three days N an half, N shall not suffer their dead bodies 2 be put in graves.
N dey dat live upon tha earth shall rejoice over ’em, N make merry, N shall send gifts one 2 another; because dese two prophets tormented ’em dat lived on tha earth.
N after three days N an half tha Spirit of life from God entered in2 ’em, N dey stood upon their feet; N great fear fell upon ’em which saw ’em.
N dey heard a great voice from heaven sayin 2 ’em, Come up here. N dey ascended up 2 heaven in a cloud; N their opps beheld ’em.

N tha same hour was there a great earthquake, N tha tenth part of tha city fell, N in tha earthquake were killed of men seven thousand: N tha remnant were affrighted, N gave glory 2 tha God of heaven.
Tha second woe is past; N, look, tha third woe comes quickly.
N tha seventh angel sounded; N there were great voices in heaven, sayin, tha kingdoms of dis world r become tha kingdoms of our Lord, N of his Christ; N he shall reign 4 ever N ever.
N tha four N twenty elders, which sat before God on their seats, fell upon their faces, N worshipped God,
Sayin, We give u thanks, O Lord God Almighty, which art, N were, N art 2 come; because u have taken 2 u ur great power, N have reigned.

N tha nations were angry, N ur wrath is come, N tha time of tha dead, dat dey should be judged, N dat u should give reward 2 ur servants tha prophets, N 2 tha saints, N ’em dat fear ur name, small N great; N should destroy ’em which destroy tha earth.
N tha temple of God was opened in heaven, N there was seen in his temple tha ark of his testament: N there were lightnings, N voices, N thunderings, N an earthquake, N great hail.

12.text: N there appeared a great wonder in heaven; a woman clothed wit tha sun, N tha moon under her feet, N upon her head a crown of twelve stars:

N there shall in no wise enter in2 it any thing dat defiles, neither whatever works abomination, or makes a lie: but dey which r written in tha Lamb’s book of life.

22.text: N he showed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of tha throne of God N of tha Lamb.

In tha midst of tha street of it, N on either side of tha river, was there tha tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, N yielded her fruit every month: N tha leaves of tha tree were 4 tha healin of tha nations.
N there shall be no more curse: but tha throne of God N of tha Lamb shall be in it; N his servants shall serve him:
N dey shall see his face; N his name shall be in their foreheads.
N there shall be no night there; N dey need no candle, neither light of tha sun; 4 tha Lord God gives ’em light: N dey shall reign 4 ever N ever.
N he said 2 me, dese sayings r faithful N true: N tha Lord God of tha holy prophets sent his angel 2 show 2 his servants tha things which must shortly be done.
Look, I come quickly: blessed is he dat keeps tha sayings of tha prophecy of dis book.
N I John saw dese things, N heard ’em. N when I had heard N seen, I fell down 2 worship before tha feet of tha angel which showed me dese things.
Then says he 2 me, See u do it not: 4 I am ur fellowservant, N of ur brothers tha prophets, N of ’em which keep tha sayings of dis book: worship God.
N he says 2 me, Seal not tha sayings of tha prophecy of dis book: 4 tha time is at hand.
He dat is unjust, let him be unjust still: N he which is filthy, let him be filthy still: N he dat is righteous, let him be righteous still: N he dat is holy, let him be holy still.
N, look, I come quickly; N my reward is wit me, 2 give every man according as his work shall be.
I am Alpha N Omega, tha beginning N tha end, tha first N tha last.
Blessed r dey dat do his commandments, dat dey may have right 2 tha tree of life, N may enter in through tha gates in2 tha city.
4 without r dogs, N sorcerers, N whoremongers, N murderers, N idolaters, N whoever loves N makes a lie.
I Jesus have sent mine angel 2 testify 2 u dese things in tha churches. I am tha root N tha offspring of David, N tha bright N morning star.
N tha Spirit N tha bride say, Come. N let him dat hears say, Come. N let him dat is athirst come. N whoever will, let him take tha water of life freely.
4 I testify 2 every man dat hears tha words of tha prophecy of dis book, If any man shall add 2 dese things, God shall add 2 him tha plagues dat r written in dis book:
N if any man shall take away from tha words of tha book of dis prophecy, God shall take away his part out of tha book of life, N out of tha holy city, N from tha things which r written in dis book.
He which testifieth dese things says, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.
Tha grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be wit u all. Amen.
